title: Selected Writings 1920-1969
author: Ho Chi Minh
desc: Anticolonialismo, independencia nacional y socialismo. De la lucha contra Francia a la resistencia contra EE.UU.
tesis: Medio siglo de escritos del líder de la revolución vietnamita: desde su estancia en París (donde descubrió el marxismo leyendo las Tesis Coloniales de Lenin) hasta la guerra contra Estados Unidos. Ho Chi Minh combinó nacionalismo anticolonial con socialismo internacionalista de una forma única: la independencia nacional no era un fin en sí mismo sino el primer paso hacia la liberación social. Vietnam derrotó a Francia y a Estados Unidos — las dos potencias imperiales más grandes del siglo XX.
ideas: Ho Chi Minh se radicalizó leyendo las Tesis Coloniales de Lenin — el primer marxista que habló directamente a los pueblos colonizados.
La revolución vietnamita demostró que un pueblo del Tercer Mundo podía derrotar a las potencias imperiales más grandes del mundo.
Ho combinó nacionalismo y socialismo: la independencia nacional es condición necesaria pero insuficiente de la liberación.
contexto: Ho Chi Minh (1890-1969) fue cocinero en Londres, fotógrafo en París, agente de la Comintern en China y fundador del Viet Minh. La declaración de independencia de Vietnam (1945) cita textualmente a Jefferson — deliberadamente, para exponer la hipocresía estadounidense. Vietnam derrotó a Japón, Francia y Estados Unidos bajo su liderazgo.

conexiones.razon: El Imperialismo de Lenin fue el texto que radicalizó a Ho Chi Minh y a toda una generación anticolonial.
Fidel y Ho lideraron revoluciones del Tercer Mundo contra el imperialismo — la misma lucha en dos continentes.
Zinn narra la guerra de Vietnam desde la disidencia estadounidense; Ho la narra desde la resistencia vietnamita.

tl: Ho Chi Minh interviene en el Congreso de Tours

You all know that French capitalism entered Indochina half a century ago. It conquered our country at bayonet point and in the name of capitalism. Since then we have not only been oppressed and exploited shamelessly, but also tortured and poisoned pitilessly.
Ho Chi Minh interviene en el Congreso de Tours

French capitalism entered Indochina half a century ago. It conquered our country at bayonet point and in the name of capitalism. Since then we have not only been oppressed and exploited shamelessly, but also tortured and poisoned pitilessly.
Ho Chi Minh funda la Unión Intercolonial
Applying Karl Marx's formula, we tell you that your emancipation can only come from your own efforts.
Ho Chi Minh interviene en el V Congreso de la Komintern

It is not an exaggeration to say that so long as the French and British Communist Parties do not apply a really active policy with regard to the colonies, and do not come into contact with the colonial peoples, their vast programmes will remain ineffective, and this, because they go counter to Leninism.
Ho Chi Minh interviene en el V Congreso de la Komintern
According to Lenin, the victory of the revolution in Western Europe depends on its close contact with the national-liberation movement against imperialism in the colonies and dependent countries.
Ho funda Asociación de Jóvenes Revolucionarios vietnamitas

The Viet Nam Young Revolutionary Comrades' Association (1925), the conference to unify Vietnamese Communist groups into a Marxist-Leninist Party (1930), the first Congress of the Indochinese Communist Party (1935) were all organized in China and enjoyed the wholehearted assistance of Chinese comrades.
Lenin y los pueblos coloniales

He was the first to point out that, without the participation of the colonial peoples, the socialist revolution could not come about. In the history of the colonial peoples weighed down with sufferings, Lenin is the creator of a new life.
Fundación del Partido Comunista Indochino
The Indochinese Communist Party has been founded. It is the Party of the working class. It will help the proletariat lead the revolution waged for the sake of all oppressed and exploited people.
Fundación del Partido Comunista Indochino

The Vietnamese Communists, formerly working separately, have united into a single party, the Indochinese Communist Party, to lead the revolutionary struggle of our entire people. To make Indochina completely independent.
Ho redacta la línea del Frente Democrático Indochino
For the time being the Party should not put forward too exacting demands (national independence, parliament, etc.). To do so is to play into the Japanese fascists' hands.
Ho funda el Viet Minh en Pac Bo

In May 1941, the Party Central Committee held its Eighth Plenum. The main question was to regard the present revolution in Viet Nam as one for national liberation; to set up the League for the Independence of Viet Nam (the Viet Minh) with the following slogan: To unite the entire people, oppose the Japanese and the French and wrest back independence.
Ho funda el Viet Minh en Pac Bo

Now, the opportunity has come for our liberation. France itself is unable to help the French colonialists rule over our country. Fellow-countrymen! Rise up! Let us organize the Association for National Salvation to fight the French and the Japanese!
Ho funda el Viet Minh en Pac Bo

The hour has struck! Raise aloft the banner of insurrection and lead the people throughout the country to overthrow the Japanese and the French! The sacred call of the Fatherland is resounding in our ears.
Giap forma la primera unidad armada del Viet Minh
The Armed Propaganda Brigade for the Liberation of Viet Nam is the first-born unit. It is the embryo of the Liberation Army and can expand from North to South, throughout Viet Nam.
Brigada Armada de Propaganda del Viet Nam

The name of the Armed Propaganda Brigade for the Liberation of Viet Nam shows that greater importance is attached to its political than to its military action. Ours being a national resistance, we must mobilize and arm the whole people.
Insurrección general del Viet Minh
The decisive hour has struck for the destiny of our people. Let all of us stand up and rely on our own strength to free ourselves.
Insurrección general del Viet Minh

The decisive hour has struck for the destiny of our people. Let all of us stand up and rely on our own strength to free ourselves. Many oppressed peoples the world over are vying with each other in wresting back independence.
Ho proclama la independencia de Vietnam

All men are created equal. They are endowed by their Creator with certain unalienable Rights; among these are Life, Liberty and the pursuit of Happiness. This immortal statement appeared in the Declaration of Independence of the United States of America in 1776. In a broader sense, it means: All the peoples on the earth are equal from birth, all the peoples have a right to live and to be happy and free.
Ho proclama la independencia de Vietnam

Viet Nam has the right to enjoy freedom and independence and in fact has become a free and independent country. The Vietnamese people are determined to mobilize all their strength to safeguard their freedom and independence.
Británicos reocupan Saigón para Francia
Let us recall these proud words of a great French revolutionary, 'I'd rather die as a free man than live as a slave.'
Franceses atacan Hanoi
On December 19, 1946, at 8 p.m. they attacked Hanoi, the capital of Viet Nam. The French colonialists' aim to reconquer our country is obvious and undeniable.
Llamamiento de Resistencia Nacional

The Vietnamese people are now facing these alternatives: either to fold their arms and bow their heads and fall back into slavery, or to struggle to the end for freedom and independence. They would rather die than lose their independence and freedom.
Truman financia la guerra francesa en Indochina
The US imperialists have failed in China, they will fail in Indochina.
Estados Unidos entra en escena en Indochina
So, apart from our principal enemy, the French colonialists, we have now another foe, the American interventionists. The US imperialists have failed in China, they will fail in Indochina.
Refundación del Partido de los Trabajadores de Vietnam

In these fifty years, the imperialists have unleashed two world wars, the most terrible wars in history... the British and French imperialists have gone downhill, while the US capitalists have become the leading imperialists, the leading reactionaries.
Caída francesa en Dien Bien Phu

Our army has liberated Dien Bien Phu. The Government and I convey our cordial greetings to you, cadres, fighters, civilian workers, young volunteers and local people, who have brilliantly fulfilled your tasks. This victory is a resounding one, but it is only the beginning.
Caída francesa en Dien Bien Phu

Our guerilla forces have grown ever stronger. From the Border Campaign to the Hoa Binh, Tay Bac and other campaigns, our regular forces have recorded repeated successes. These victories plus Dien Bien Phu have brought about an important change.
VI Pleno aprueba Coexistencia Pacífica
The US imperialists not only are the enemy of the world's people but are becoming the main and direct enemy of the Vietnamese, Cambodian and Lao peoples.
Acuerdos de Ginebra y partición del país

In Indochina, the United States and France seem united in coping with our resistance, but in fact the United States wants to oust the French and has already put Ngo Dinh Diem, its zealous valet, at the head of a puppet government.
Diem cancela las elecciones de reunificación vietnamita

Yet the warlike US imperialists, breaking their own pledge, have openly sabotaged the Geneva Agreements. They rigged up the traitorous puppet administration and launched a war of aggression in the South of our country.
Sobre la moral revolucionaria

Capitalism and imperialism are very dangerous enemies. Backward habits and traditions are also big enemies. The third enemy is individualism, the petty-bourgeois mentality which still lurks in each of us. Individualism is a cruel enemy of socialism.
Ho narra su conversión al leninismo

In those Theses, there were political terms that were difficult to understand. But by reading them again and again finally I was able to grasp the essential part. What emotion, enthusiasm, enlightenment and confidence they communicated to me! I wept for joy. Sitting by myself in my room, I would shout as if I were addressing large crowds: 'Dear martyr compatriots! This is what we need, this is our path to liberation!'
Ho narra su conversión al leninismo

What emotion, enthusiasm, enlightenment and confidence they communicated to me! I wept for joy. Sitting by myself in my room, I would shout: Dear martyr compatriots! This is what we need, this is our path to liberation!
III Congreso del Partido y socialismo en el Norte

So long as we have not driven the American imperialists out of the South, our people will know no rest. The struggle for the defence of peace and for national reunification cannot be separated from the struggle against American imperialism.
Conferencia Política Especial de Hanoi
Immediately after the Geneva Conference, the imperialist powers instigated by the United States set up the so-called 'South-East Asia Defence Organisation' which was in fact an aggressive bloc.
Escalada masiva de tropas en Vietnam, 1965

Viet Nam is one country, the Vietnamese are one nation; nobody is allowed to infringe this sacred right. The US imperialists must respect the Geneva Agreements, withdraw from South Viet Nam and immediately stop their attacks on North Viet Nam.
Ho responde a la escalada de Johnson

For the past few months, they have frenziedly extended the war to the North of our country. In defiance of the 1954 Geneva Agreements and international law, they have used hundreds of aircraft and dozens of warships to bomb and shell North Viet Nam continually... US President Johnson has also loudly threatened to use force to subjugate our people. This is but foolish illusion. Our people will never submit.
Ho proclama las consignas de resistencia prolongada
Even if the battle should last five, ten, twenty years or longer, we will resolutely fight on till complete victory.
Ho proclama Nada más precioso que la independencia

The war may last five, ten, twenty or more years; Hanoi, Haiphong and other cities and enterprises may be destroyed; but the Vietnamese people will not be intimidated! Nothing is more precious than independence and freedom.
Ho proclama Nada más precioso que la independencia

The war may last five, ten, twenty or more years; Hanoi, Haiphong and other cities and enterprises may be destroyed; but the Vietnamese people will not be intimidated! Nothing is more precious than independence and freedom.
Cincuentenario del Octubre y línea internacional

Any nation, even a small one, which is closely united and resolutely fighting according to a correct political and military line, and enjoying active support from the socialist camp, will be able to defeat any imperialist aggressor.
Ofensiva del Tet
This spring outshines the previous ones, News of victory rejoices the whole country. South and North emulate each other in fighting the US aggressors, Forward! Complete victory will be ours!
Ofensiva del Tet

Since early 1968, the war of resistance in the South has reached a new stage: our compatriots have launched a general offensive and concerted uprisings in the cities, achieving exploits which have shaken the United States and the whole world.
EE.UU. detiene bombardeos sobre Vietnam del Norte

Under the impact of the great victories won by our armed forces and people in both zones, especially in the South since early spring this year, the United States government was forced on Nov. 1st, 1968 to end unconditionally its bombing and shelling on the whole territory of the Democratic Republic of Viet Nam.
Ho Chi Minh denuncia el burocratismo del Partido

Because of their individualism, they flinch from hardships and difficulties and sink into corruption, depravation, waste and luxury. They crave for fame and profits, positions and power... In short, individualism is the source of many wrongdoings.
Ho Chi Minh redacta su Testamento

Our mountains will always be, our rivers will always be, our people will always be; The American invaders defeated, we will rebuild our land ten times more beautiful. No matter what difficulties and hardships lie ahead, our people are sure of total victory. We, a small nation, will have earned the signal honour of defeating, through heroic struggle, two big imperialisms — the French and the American — and of making a worthy contribution to the world national liberation movement.
Ho Chi Minh redacta su Testamento

Our mountains will always be, our rivers will always be, our people will always be; the American invaders defeated, we will rebuild our land ten times more beautiful. The US imperialists will certainly have to quit.
